date_note: Date of Silverstripe's security release as listed on its security releases page.
title: Silverstripe patches two critical flaws: unauthenticated RCE via forms and login bypass for accounts without a password
summary: Silverstripe's security releases page lists two critical advisories released on 24 November: SS-2026-008, unauthenticated remote code execution via form submissions (CVSS 9.8), and SS-2026-009, a login bypass for accounts without a password (CVSS 9.1). Neither has a CVE listed. SecurityBrief Australia reports no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation. Fixes are in silverstripe/framework releases, plus template-engine 1.0.3 for CMS 6.
plain: Silverstripe released fixes for two critical flaws in its CMS: one lets an unauthenticated attacker run code through a form, the other allows login to accounts that have no password.
exec: Websites built on Silverstripe CMS face a critical remote code execution flaw and a login bypass until patched.
action: Silverstripe's page says to update silverstripe/framework to a fixed release and, on CMS 6.x, also silverstripe/template-engine to 1.0.3.

validation.note: Vendor security releases page read (primary), plus SecurityBrief Australia. The article reports no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation; the vendor page gives no CVE.
